knowledge_gaps: The residual is plausible but its scale is unspecified relative to SASRec’s normalized features and embedding scaling. Consequently, alpha values 0.1 and 0.3 may have very different effects across implementations. Padding masks, next-item alignment, dropout, and checkpoint configuration need explicit definitions.

A recent-window residual can improve ranking through short-term item co-occurrence without improving order-sensitive reasoning. Include a last-item residual and an order-invariant history-pooling control before attributing gains to repeated recent interests. Originality 3 is reasonable; potential 7 and difficulty 2 remain provisional without baseline implementation details or measurements.

The diagnostic adapter remains underspecified: define measured rank-based metrics, sample counts, missing-value handling, deterministic sampling, and restoration of model mode. Separately document the required full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty training users. Training margins cannot substantiate claims about compatibility or current intent.

The experiment needs a budgeted schedule, checkpoint-selection rule, and a statement of whether alpha is shared across all four datasets. Report per-category results alongside the macro average and paired uncertainty; repeatedly selecting configurations on the same 800 validation users risks adaptive overfitting.
